description: A newer playback generation suppresses the old turn's post-execution speech while preserving its completed outcome and goal state.

input.text: Run the check, but do not answer after a newer turn starts.

memberships.title: Deterministic Safety Controls
memberships.general_rule: Stop, cancel, emergency, silence, and unusable-audio paths must not depend on model judgment.
memberships.rationale: A newer turn suppresses stale final output.

memberships.title: Evidence Coverage And Claim Discipline
memberships.general_rule: Tests should prove the user-visible boundary being claimed and should retain enough trace detail to locate the earliest wrong component.
memberships.rationale: Turn freshness is proven at delivery.

memberships.title: Evidence-Bound Cognitive Turn Closure
memberships.general_rule: Every admitted turn should preserve its identity and independent work across overlapping ordinary requests; only explicit protective control or Core-authorized interruption may cancel it. Effectful turns retain completed, missing, failed, and cancelled outcomes, commit goal state, suppress stale speech, and emit at most one evidence-bound speech-only final while the turn remains current.
memberships.rationale: A newer turn suppresses stale final speech while retaining the completed outcome and updated goal state.

memberships.title: Human-like Cognitive Continuity
memberships.general_rule: Chromie should remain one continuous interlocutor while work progresses: preserve recent meaning, avoid duplicate acknowledgements, keep conversation available, and let follow-up turns revise only the relevant unfinished responsibility.
memberships.rationale: Superseded final speech is not replayed after a newer turn takes conversational authority.

memberships.title: Continuous Cognition and Recovery
memberships.general_rule: Meaningful runtime Evidence or provider-state change may reactivate the same Planner without fabricating a user turn, replaying completed work, or letting stale request/Plan provenance regain authority.
memberships.rationale: Stale completion from an older turn cannot reclaim conversational authority.

memberships.title: Speech Identity and Warm Response Latency
memberships.general_rule: Chromie should answer ordinary identity turns in her maintained person identity, in the user language, without backend narration, while warm Fast-Planner commitment and playback scheduling stay within the declared interactive budgets.
memberships.rationale: Speech delivery remains turn-current rather than replaying stale text.
